bibl.title: Von eisernen Ringen: Neue Fragmente zu SM II 71 in der Jenaer Papyrussammlung.
bibl.seg: Daniela Colomo & Marius Gerhardt, Von eisernen Ringen: Neue Fragmente zu SM II 71 in der Jenaer Papyrussammlung.
bibl.note: Editio princeps of three papyrus fragments belonging to the University of Jena (P. Jen. Inv. D1; Aswan, 1st cent. BC). They are part of the same roll as Suppl. Mag. II, 71 (= LDAB 6792).
